description: US schools in a city from GreatSchools: name, GreatSchools rating (1-10) and label, sub-ratings (test scores, student progress, equity...), school type (public, charter, private), grade levels, district, address, enrollment, students per teacher, % low-income, parent rating and review count, coordinates and profile URL, plus the total number of schools. Filter by level (preschool, elementary, middle, high) and type; 25 per page, best rated first. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City name, e.g. San Francisco, Austin (required)

level.description: Optional: preschool, elementary, middle or high

state.description: US state code, e.g. CA, TX, NY (required)
